Package neupaths.api

Class BridgeCell

java.lang.Object
neupaths.api.Cell
neupaths.api.BridgeCell
public class BridgeCell extends Cell
NeuPaths cell type for bridging stimuli across domains. A bridge cell maintains a presence in multiple domains and uses subscriptions to pull stimuli across domain boundaries.

For example, if trying to pull stimuli from domain D2 to domain D1, a bridge cell would have synapses in each domain (Peer or Listener). The bridge cell would use subscriptions in domain D2 to pull stimuli to the bridge cell, and cells in domain D1 would use subscriptions to pull stimuli from the bridge cell.

    • BridgeCell

      public BridgeCell(String name, String[] synapseNames, BridgeSubscriptionSpec[] subscriptions, byte[] cryptoKey)
      Creates a new BridgeCell object.
      Parameters:
      name - The cell's name at runtime. This name should be unique across the entire cell system.
      synapseNames - The synapses this cell listens on and/or connects to.
      subscriptions - The subscriptions this cell advertises. If the subscription array is empty (null or empty array), the cell operates as a RouterCell.
      cryptoKey - The stimulus encryption key. Specify null to disable encryption using a user-specified key. If disabled, the stimuli will still be encrypted as part of NeuPaths protocol encryption.
